visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two domestic cats are positioned on a light gray, plush fabric sofa. One cat has calico markings (white, brown, and black) and sits alertly in the center, looking directly at the camera with large, curious eyes. To its left, an orange and white tabby cat is partially visible, looking away towards the side. The lighting is bright and even, suggesting a well-lit indoor home environment. A decorative cushion shaped like a Shiba Inu's head is visible in the upper left corner on the sofa. (2) The calico cat responds to the off-camera owner by opening its mouth in a wide meow, showing its pink tongue and small teeth. Its whiskers are fanned out. Yellow and white text overlays with cartoonish outlines appear around the cat's head. The orange cat remains seated beside it, relatively still. The camera remains in a steady medium close-up, capturing the cat's facial expressions clearly against the neutral background of the sofa. (3) The camera focuses on the orange and white cat, which remains silent and stares forward with a blank, slightly confused expression. To emphasize its lack of response, digital "LOADING" bars and multiple blue question mark graphics are edited onto the screen, floating around the cat's head. The background remains the soft, wrinkled texture of the gray sofa, and the calico cat is now partially out of frame to the right. (4) The scene cuts to a different location within the home, showing a Shiba Inu dog sitting on a gray tiled floor in front of a wooden cabinet or door. The dog has its mouth open in a wide, happy-looking pant, revealing its tongue and teeth, almost appearing to laugh. A final text overlay in Traditional Chinese appears near the dog. The lighting remains bright, and the camera angle shifts to a slightly lower eye-level perspective to match the dog's height.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-tempo, playful electronic synthesizer melody serving as background music. A male voice with a friendly, casual tone and moderate pitch speaks in Traditional Chinese, addressing the pets. There is a high signal-to-noise ratio with minimal ambient room tone. A short, bubbly "pop" sound effect triggers as the first text overlay appears on screen. (2) A sharp "ding" sound effect occurs, marking the moment the cat meows. The cat's meow is a clear, high-pitched vocalization. The male speaker's voice continues, rising in pitch as he encourages the second cat. The upbeat BGM continues at a steady volume, and a mechanical "click" or "pop" sound effect coincides with the appearance of new subtitle text. (3) As the orange cat stares silently, a series of comedic, digital "error" or "thinking" sound effects play, sounding like a stuttering computer or a winding clock. The male speaker's tone becomes slightly more teasing and humorous. The background music remains constant, providing a rhythmic base. A "boing" sound effect marks the appearance of the question mark graphics. (4) A quick "swoosh" transition sound effect leads into the final segment. The male voice makes a final remark with a falling intonation. The sounds of the dog's soft panting and rhythmic breathing are audible. A final, bright synthesized chord or "ta-da" style sound effect plays to conclude the video as the BGM fades out.
